title: My Pug Is Still Mad at Me. He Accepts Payment Though.
description:
I came home after a 3 day trip and Jabba is not speaking to me. He sits facing the sofa and side-eyes me twice, just to make sure I can see him ignoring me. The apology gift, a new toy: one look, chin up, rejected. Last resort, the treat pouch: without even looking at me he eats the treat in one bite and goes straight back to ignoring me, chin up. Still mad. Accepts payment.

Hot take: pugs don't forgive, they just accept payment. Pug owners, how long does yours sulk after a trip?

#pug #funnydogs #puglife
